title: Assessments Left Standing Against the Security Hold on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement
content:
Where a security hold is already standing against an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement, the collective is not without cover for a damage assessment raised on it, and part of that assessment is left standing against the hold rather than reached for at the counter.

## The rule

Where the rental account carries an assessment raised against the agreement, and the security hold standing against it is at or above that assessment, the assessment is left standing against that hold up to the deferral cap. The deferral cap is 50.00 USD.

Where the rental account carries an assessment raised against the agreement and the security hold standing against it is below that assessment, the whole of the hold standing is left standing against the assessment.

In any other case nothing is left standing against the hold under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Assessment raised on the agreement | The hold standing against it | Left standing against the hold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| some | at or above the assessment | the assessment, up to 50.00 USD |
| some | below the assessment | the whole of the hold standing |
| none | any | nothing under this heading |

A hold standing at exactly the assessment sits in the first row, not the second.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

- The account carries an assessment of 22.25 USD and a hold of 400.00 USD stands against the agreement: the hold is at or above the assessment, so 22.25 USD is left standing against it, that being below the cap of 50.00 USD.
- The account carries an assessment of 180.00 USD and a hold of 400.00 USD stands: the hold is at or above the assessment, so 50.00 USD is left standing against it, the cap biting.
- The account carries an assessment of 180.00 USD and a hold of 90.00 USD stands: the hold is below the assessment, so the whole 90.00 USD standing is left against it.
- The account carries no assessment: nothing is left standing against the hold under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**What the hold standing is.** It is what was placed against the agreement less what has already gone back, taken as never below zero.
